name: Prachi
quote: Mehul got the feel of the label before he wrote a line of code. The site reads like our lookbook: calm, editorial, and easy to shop from on a phone.

name: Vidhi Parmar
quote: I wanted a portfolio that moves the way my films do. U Scale built exactly that, and it is now the first link I send to every brand.

name: Yash
quote: Site and socials came from one person with one plan. Same voice, same visuals, every week, and I never had to chase anyone for an update.

name: Raj Patel

name: Vrushab Jain
quote: Mehul designed and built everything himself, so nothing got lost between a designer and a developer. What we approved in Figma is what went live.
